rec.name: PDP Gallery Image Info Button (Caption + Tooltip)

what.text: A caption bar sits directly under the main PDP product image. It shows a short line of text (e.g. a product or image note) with a round "i" info icon on the right. Tapping or hovering the icon opens a small tooltip bubble with the same or extended text, pointing at the icon. The text is set per product (via a product metafield 'info buttons') and can be shown for specific gallery images.

why.text: Short image-level notes answer small questions at the moment the shopper is looking at the image, e.g. what is included, a size or usage note, or a disclaimer. This reduces uncertainty and the need to scroll to the description. The tooltip is progressive disclosure: the page stays clean and detail is available on demand. This is an inference; the ticket does not state the reasoning.

how.text: Add a product metafield (single-line text, 'info buttons') in the Shopify admin under Product metafields. The theme's gallery media block reads it and renders a caption row under the image, with an 'i' icon that toggles a tooltip. Per the comments, the first version showed one text on all images. It was later reworked so individual points can be created and sorted and assigned to specific images, with a video walkthrough as the client guide. The layout is fixed: the position can be above the image, at the top or bottom, or underneath it. Colour, background colour and font size are editable in the theme customizer. Fully unique content per image or product needs a metafield or image alt-text solution. The exact structure of the reworked multi-point setup is only shown in Loom videos, which are not visible here.

items: Position: above the image (top or bottom) or underneath the image
Content per product via the 'info buttons' metafield (single-line text)
Multiple info points creatable and sortable, assignable per image (reworked version, details only in video)

dependencies.text: Product metafield 'info buttons' (single-line text) defined in Shopify admin. Custom Liquid/JS in the theme's PDP gallery to render the caption row and tooltip. Per-image assignment of multiple points needs extra structure (e.g. a list metafield or image alt text). The ticket says the feature was missing from the theme codebase at one point and had to be re-implemented, so check it exists before reuse.

items: Support tickets or questions about product contents

images.caption: Desktop close-up: caption bar under the product image with an 'i' icon and an open tooltip bubble above it
Mobile PDP: caption line with 'i' icon under the main gallery image, above the slider counter (1/12)
Shopify admin product metafields with the 'info buttons' single-line text field
